fixes.explanation: Right on the money. The LORD says, "…the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there." (Exodus 8:22) He calls it special treatment. Flies everywhere in Egypt, and Goshen gets a quiet afternoon. I've had a junk drawer with more dust than that, and I never got a day off from it.

Not quite, friend. Pharaoh says, "Go, sacrifice to your God within this land." (Exodus 8:25) Moses answers, "It would not be right to do that…" (Exodus 8:26) His reason is that the sacrifices would be detestable to the Egyptians, so he says no to staying.
